text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Joaquim Chissano said in his annual state of the nation address that Mozambicans could be proud of their achievements in 1996 with growth in GDP of about six percent and a 24 percent increase in commodity exports. Inflation dropped from 54 percent in 1995 to 16.6 percent in 1996 and the national currency was devalued by only five percent.

- Health specialists from 18 countries in sub-Saharan Africa are meeting in Maputo to take stock of last year's medical research activities in the region and will plan ahead for the 12 months beginning in June.
